PUNJAB COMMUNITY BASED CONSERVANCY
RULES, 2023
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
31st May, 2023]
No.
SOP(WL)12-2/2007(A), dated 26.5.2023.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 46 of the Punjab
Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974 (II
of 1974), Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be cited as the Punjab Community Based Conservancy Rules, 2023.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In the rules, unless the context or subject
otherwise requires:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and
Management) Act, 1974 (II of 1974);
(b) "Committee"
means the community conservation committee constituted under the rules;
(c) "Community"
means the local community in ownership or legal possession of the land under
the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 (XVII of 1967);
(d) "Community
based conservancy" means protection, preservation, conservation,
management and harvest of wildlife carried out in the zone through the
committee;
(e) "Department"
means the Forestry, Wildlife and Fisheries Department;
(f) "Director
General" means the Director General (Wildlife and Parks) Punjab;
(g) "Rules"
means the Punjab Community Based Conservancy Rules, 2023;
(h) "Schedule"
means the Schedule appended to the rules; and
(i) "Zone"
means the community based conservancy zone notified under rule 3 of the rules.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the rules shall have the same
meaning as assigned to it in the Act.
3. Declaration
of zones.---(1) The Department
may, within sixty days of commencement of the rules, carry out a survey of
potential areas, based on the incidence of predominance of specific wildlife
species, for declaration of zones to identify the community for community based
conservation of wildlife and habitat.
(2) The
zone may include land owned by private persons, shamilat lands, forest
land and state land not declared as protected area.
(3) The
Department may add, alter or subtract the zone declared under sub-rule (1), on
the basis of subsequent survey.
(4) The
survey shall identify and enumerate the community falling under the zone.
4. Approval
of community based conservancy.---(1)
After declaration of zone under rule 3, the Department may invite proposals
from the community falling under the respective zone for proposed community
based conservancy.
(2) The
community shall apply for proposed community based conservancy through a
proposed committee, in odd numbers, of the respective zone.
(3) The
proposal for approval of proposed community based conservancy and committee
shall contain:
(a) application
from the proposed committee;
(b) management
plan prepared by an expert from the panel specified by the Director-General or
an expert in wildlife conservation approved by the Director General in the form
as set out in the Schedule-I;
(c) affidavit
by all members of the proposed committee for compliance of measures as
stipulated under rule 9; and
(d) organizational
structure of the proposed committee with specification of following office
bearers and other members:
(i) President;
(ii) General
Secretary;
(iii) Finance Secretary; and
(iv) ten
to sixteen other members from the respective zone.
(4) Upon
receipt of proposal, the office of the Director General shall require:
(a) verification
report of the concerned Deputy Director as mentioned under rules 6 and 7; and
(b) certificate
from the Assistant Commissioner concerned that the community supports the
establishment of the proposed committee for the conservation of wildlife and
its habitat in the zone in the form as set out in the Schedule-II:
Provided
that the Assistant Commissioner shall carry out proceedings of Ijlas-e-Aam in
the concerned local area in accordance with the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967
(XVII of 1967).
